name: Sumit Shinde
title: Technical Writer
bio: Sumit Shinde is a Technical Writer at FlowFuse specializing in industrial automation and manufacturing. In the past three years, he has built industrial applications and authored more than 100 technical articles covering industrial connectivity, unified data architecture, production metrics, and quality management for modern manufacturing.
facts: Experienced love at first sight with Node-RED and enjoys writing and reading about it.
Loves helping and spending time with stray animals and owns a cat.
Passionate about reading, running, and exploring historical places.
